# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/grompp

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS grompp module.

The GROMACS preprocessor module needs to be fed with the input system and the dynamics parameters to create a portable binary run input file TPR. The simulation parameters can be specified by two methods: 1.The predefined mdp settings defined at simulation_type property or 2.A custom mdp file defined at the input_mdp_path argument. These two methods are mutually exclusive. In both cases can be further modified by adding parameters to the mdp section in the yaml configuration file. The simulation parameter names and default values can be consulted in the official MDP specification.

Nextflow adapter of the [Grompp](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.grompp) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_GROMPP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/grompp'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_GROMPP(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_gro_path` | yes | gro | Path to the input GROMACS structure GRO file |
| `input_top_zip_path` | yes | zip | Path to the input GROMACS topology TOP and ITP files in zip format |
| `input_cpt_path` | no | cpt | Path to the input GROMACS checkpoint file CPT |
| `input_ndx_path` | no | ndx | Path to the input GROMACS index files NDX |
| `input_mdp_path` | no | mdp | Path to the input GROMACS MDP file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_tpr_path` | yes | tpr | Path to the output portable binary run file TPR |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Grompp properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_tpr_path: 'tpr']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_GROMPP' {
        ext.properties = [simulation_type: 'minimization']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mdp` | object | {} | MDP options specification. |
| `simulation_type` | string | null | Default options for the mdp file. Each one creates a different mdp file. Values: minimization, nvt, npt, free, ions, index. |
| `maxwarn` | integer | 0 | Maximum number of allowed warnings. If simulation_type is index default is 10. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
